lastChange.note: Hypermetapunk 0.5: the plate and the moods. Plate (Hypermetapunk.plate in components/plate.js, an add-on after pen.js: one drawing printed as a neon halftone, a xerox with one red or a solid cut, the sound word as its one accent; family F9) and looks[].mood (lit or impact; family F10). The front page's headline stands at chrome's size on phones.
